clippings.speaker: Wes Craven
clippings.quote: When we were shooting the ending sequence in a house in Santa Rosa, every time the sun set, Neve and I would go outside for five minutes and watch the sunset together. I think we sort of felt like, ‘This is where you find your calm.'
clippings.title: Interview: Neve Campbell
clippings.context: Craven recalling the Scream shoot for a Rolling Stone profile of Campbell during the Scream 2 era; the reporter's attribution "recalls director Wes Craven" is cut from the middle.

clippings.speaker: Wes Craven
clippings.quote: I think Neve runs very, very deep, … and is incredibly physically strong, so she can deal with the really killing schedule that she is on.
clippings.title: Interview: Neve Campbell
clippings.context: Craven on Campbell in the same 1997 Rolling Stone profile, while she juggled Party of Five and the Scream films; "he adds" attribution cut.

clippings.speaker: Wes Craven
clippings.quote: Neve tried to think of one clever line after another to replace that, … I said, ‘Well, just say it once.'
clippings.title: Interview: Neve Campbell
clippings.context: Craven on Campbell resisting Sidney's mean "I'd get Tori Spelling" line in Scream, from the 1997 Rolling Stone profile.

clippings.speaker: Neve Campbell
clippings.quote: Wes has a really great eye and ear, and taste in people, with the casting, writing and all the people who get involved in the film. He’s also just phenomenal with timing, humor and scaring people.
clippings.title: Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and David Arquette Interview SCREAM 4
clippings.context: Campbell at the Scream 4 press day, asked what keeps Craven's sequels scary.

clippings.speaker: Neve Campbell
clippings.quote: My life wouldn’t be what it is without him. I will be forever grateful for his brilliant direction, his wicked sense of humor and his consummate kindness and friendship.
clippings.title: Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox Remember Horror Master Wes Craven
clippings.context: Campbell's statement after Craven's death in August 2015; Moviefone quotes the statement she gave to Entertainment Weekly.

clippings.speaker: Neve Campbell
clippings.quote: Wes was a master. He was the best with this genre. Well, with other genres as well, but just a phenomenal talent and amazing energy and a father figure to us.
clippings.title: Scream's Neve Campbell And David Arquette Reminisce About Working With Wes Craven - Exclusive
clippings.context: Campbell on making the 2022 Scream, the first in the series without Craven.

clippings.speaker: Neve Campbell
clippings.quote: He would sort of glide onto set, and sit down, and get behind the monitor, and you would do these horrific things, and you would just hear [laughter].
clippings.title: Neve Campbell Remembers Wes Craven: "He Just Loved Making Movies"
clippings.context: Campbell on Craven's twisted sense of humor on the Scream set; originally said on a podcast interview (The Evolution of Horror's Hello Sidney), reported by HorrorGeekLife.

notes: Craven-on-Campbell is thin; all three come from one 1997 Rolling Stone profile (served openly). Bloody Disgusting (403) and Hero Magazine (JS-only) Craven interviews could not be read.
